Expeditions

Marine Megafauna Foundation

Collecting observations in coastal Mozambique

Explore the work

ProjectsResearchExpeditionsDiscuss a project

Location: coastal Mozambique.

Period working with MMF: 2018–2019, in Mozambique and remotely.

My field contribution: marine megafauna data collection during research dives and ocean safaris.

I collected marine megafauna field data with the Marine Megafauna Foundation in coastal Mozambique. Research dives and ocean safaris provided the setting for observing animals and contributing records to the team's work.

Supporting the organization

My work with MMF also included building an automated manta sponsorship workflow. It connected WordPress, WooCommerce, and Printful for supporter purchases and fulfillment.

This engagement brought together field data collection and software supporting the organization's day-to-day work.

Related project

Dive the Data: a citizen science platform I co-founded and designed for recording and exploring marine megafauna sightings.

Connecting fieldwork, research, and design

My work brings together experience in product design, underwater research, and scientific publishing. I'm interested in ecological change, deep time, and how people participate in thriving ecosystems across generations.
